Name: Spouse room redesign
Author: casualkira
Description:
ATTN:  three objects in Abigail's room (namely the floor cushion, the sword and the drawer next to the sword) float in front of character. Or, to say it another way, the character ends up walking behind it like it was a bush. I am unable to continue work on mods at this time but I can update and credit anyone who has interest in fixing it, and I apologize for the oversight!

I felt that once your spouse moved in their small room didn't truly reflect their personality- so I set out to change that! Please leave feedback, questions or comments!

Take this into your stardew folder content>maps>drag the file and replace the existing!
